conversations.content: Count from one to ten.
One two three four five six seven eight nine ten.
List ten colors.
Red orange yellow green blue indigo violet black white gray.
Name ten animals.
Cat dog horse cow sheep goat tiger lion bear rabbit.
Write a short sentence.
The quick brown fox jumps over the calm and sleepy dog.
List ten fruits.
Apple banana orange grape peach pear mango melon plum kiwi.
Name ten cities.
Paris London Tokyo Seoul Beijing Madrid Rome Berlin Cairo Lima.
List ten tools.
Hammer saw drill wrench pliers chisel level file clamp screwdriver.
Name ten shapes.
Circle square triangle rectangle oval star cube cone sphere hexagon.
List ten materials.
Wood steel glass paper stone cotton leather copper clay rubber.
Name ten jobs.
Teacher doctor engineer farmer artist writer chef pilot nurse builder.
List ten sports.
Football tennis cricket hockey baseball rugby golf boxing skiing cycling.
Name ten subjects.
Math physics chemistry biology history geography music art language computing.
